name: layjou-bubble
description: Layjou Bubble — jeu de match-3 avec le robot Layjou (Capacitor + AdMob)

scripts.android:apk: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:open: cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android:demo: node tools/demo-ads.mjs on && (npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug); s=$?; node tools/demo-ads.mjs off; npx cap sync android >/dev/null; exit $s
scripts.android:bundle: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
